spectators.name: Denji (Chainsaw Man)
spectators.look: lean teen whose head is a grey chainsaw bar jutting up and forward from his forehead above a wide jagged-toothed jaw, chainsaw blades sprouting from both forearms, white collared shirt with a loose black necktie, black trousers, a pull-cord handle hanging from his chest
spectators.fallbackLook: lean figure whose head is a grey motorized saw-blade bar sticking up from the forehead above a wide jagged-toothed jaw, toothed saw blades jutting from both forearms, a white collared shirt with a loose black necktie, black trousers and a pull-cord handle on his chest
spectators.idle: slouching, chainsaw arms lowered, blades idling
spectators.cheer: chainsaw arms flung out to the sides, revving with sparks
spectators.shocked: leaning back, jaw gaping wide, blades sputtering

spectators.name: Pochita
spectators.look: small round orange dog-like devil with a grey chainsaw blade sticking out of its forehead, tiny black eyes, a pink tongue, stubby little legs and a short tail ending in a pull-cord handle
spectators.fallbackLook: small round orange dog-like creature with a grey toothed saw blade sticking out of its forehead, tiny black eyes, a pink tongue, stubby legs and a short tail ending in a pull-cord handle
spectators.idle: sitting with its tongue out, tail wagging
spectators.cheer: hopping on stubby legs, forehead chainsaw whirring
spectators.shocked: flattened on its belly, eyes huge

spectators.name: Power
spectators.look: wild young woman with long straight strawberry-blonde hair, two small red horns on her forehead, golden eyes with cross-shaped pupils and a sharp-toothed grin, untucked white collared shirt with a loose black necktie, black trousers
spectators.fallbackLook: wild young woman with long straight strawberry-blonde hair, two small red horns on her forehead, golden eyes with cross-shaped pupils, a sharp-toothed grin, an untucked white shirt with a loose black necktie and black trousers
spectators.idle: arms crossed, chin raised, smug fanged grin
spectators.cheer: thumb jabbed at her own chest, cackling
spectators.shocked: cowering behind raised arms, teeth chattering

spectators.name: Aki Hayakawa
spectators.look: serious young man with black hair tied in a small topknot at the back of his head, tired blue eyes and small stud earrings, black suit jacket over a white shirt and black necktie, black trousers, a katana in a dark sheath strapped across his back
spectators.fallbackLook: serious young man with black hair tied in a small topknot, tired blue eyes, small stud earrings, a black suit over a white shirt and black necktie, a sheathed katana strapped across his back
spectators.cheer: a restrained raised fist, slight smile
spectators.shocked: hand reaching back for his sword, eyes wide

spectators.name: Makima
spectators.look: composed young woman with coral-red hair in a long low braid over her shoulder and side-swept bangs, golden eyes with concentric ring pupils and a faint calm smile, crisp white collared shirt with a black necktie tucked in, black trousers, black shoes
spectators.fallbackLook: composed young woman with coral-red hair in a long low braid and side-swept bangs, golden eyes with concentric ringed pupils, a faint calm smile, a crisp white shirt with a tucked-in black necktie and black trousers
spectators.idle: hands folded in front of her, serene unblinking smile
spectators.cheer: a slow polite clap, the same calm smile
spectators.shocked: barely reacting, a slight head tilt, ringed eyes watching coldly

spectators.name: Kobeni Higashiyama
spectators.look: timid young woman with messy dark brown hair in a short low ponytail, a small mole under one eye, teary frightened eyes, black suit jacket over a white shirt and black necktie, black trousers
spectators.fallbackLook: timid young woman with messy dark brown hair in a short low ponytail, a small mole under one eye, teary frightened eyes, a black suit jacket over a white shirt and black necktie, black trousers
spectators.idle: wringing her hands, trembling, eyes darting around
spectators.cheer: sobbing and cheering at once, both hands raised
spectators.shocked: screaming with hands on her head, tears flying

spectators.name: Himeno
spectators.look: laid-back young woman with short messy dark hair, a black eyepatch over her right eye and a relaxed lopsided smile, open black suit jacket over a white shirt with a loosened black necktie, black trousers
spectators.fallbackLook: laid-back young woman with short messy dark hair, a black eyepatch over one eye, a lopsided smile, an open black suit jacket over a white shirt with a loosened black necktie, black trousers
spectators.idle: hands in her pockets, relaxed lopsided smile
spectators.cheer: one arm raised high, winking her visible eye
spectators.shocked: leaning back, her one eye wide, hand at her mouth

spectators.name: Kishibe
spectators.look: tall lean middle-aged man with swept-back dark hair greying at the temples, stubble and faint scars on his face, rings pierced through his lower lip and half-closed bored eyes, rumpled black suit, white shirt with a loosened black tie, a small metal hip flask in hand
spectators.fallbackLook: tall lean middle-aged man with swept-back dark hair greying at the temples, stubble, faint facial scars, lip piercings, bored half-closed eyes, a rumpled black suit with a loosened black tie and a small metal hip flask
spectators.idle: sipping from his metal flask, bored stare
spectators.cheer: flask raised in a lazy toast

spectators.name: Angel Devil
spectators.look: slim androgynous young man with shoulder-length sandy-beige hair and sleepy pale eyes, a thin glowing gold halo floating above his head, small white feathered wings on his back, white collared shirt with a black necktie, black trousers
spectators.fallbackLook: slim androgynous young man with shoulder-length sandy-beige hair, sleepy pale eyes, a thin glowing gold halo above his head, small white feathered wings, a white shirt with a black necktie and black trousers
spectators.idle: slouching with a bored, sleepy look
spectators.shocked: wings flared out, halo flickering, eyes wide

spectators.name: Beam
spectators.look: lanky fiend with a grey-blue shark head on a human body (pointed snout, rows of sharp white teeth, a small dorsal fin on top), white collared shirt with a black necktie, black suit jacket and trousers
spectators.fallbackLook: lanky figure with a grey-blue shark head on a human body, pointed snout, rows of sharp white teeth and a small dorsal fin on top, wearing a white shirt, black necktie and black suit
spectators.idle: fidgeting excitedly, staring at the ring and drooling
spectators.cheer: arms waving out to the sides, jaws wide open shouting
spectators.shocked: jaw hanging unhinged, fin quivering, hands on his head
